title: What Are the Attributes of God?
subtitle: Understanding the divine attributes of God from a Catholic perspective
description: A biblical, theological and Catholic explanation of God's attributes, including His infinity, eternity, immutability, omniscience, omnipotence, goodness, love, wisdom, justice, mercy, holiness and faithfulness.
